name: khelpcenter
description: Khelpcenter is an application that shows documentation for KDE Applications as well as displays manual and info pages.

pre: test -f /opt/qt6/lib/cmake/Qt6WebEngineWidgets/Qt6WebEngineWidgetsConfig.cmake || { echo "khelpcenter: Qt6WebEngineWidgets is missing under /opt/qt6" >&2; echo "Rebuild WebEngine: alps install --force qtwebengine" >&2; exit 1; }
user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=$KF6_PREFIX \
      -D CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$QT6DIR        \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release         \
      -D BUILD_TESTING=OFF                \
      -W no-dev .
